title: print oci-hook stdout/err by default on errors
body:
For a user it is hard to figure out why a hook failed today. We should print the hooks stdout/err as part of the error to provide the info. IF we want to avoid buffering an unlimited amount of output potentially on stderr we could cap the output at something like 8K which would still be good enough for the vast majority of cases.

Since we recently added support for the `run.oci.hooks.stdout/stderr` annotations a user could use them now like `--annotation run.oci.hooks.stdout=/dev/stdout --annotation run.oci.hooks.stderr=/dev/stderr`, however a user would need to know they exists and a larger problem they always dump the output even on a success case. And another problem with the annotation is in case of multiple hooks it is impossible to know which one printed what.
